visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with reddish-brown hair tied back, wearing a black blazer and white top, stands outdoors. She smiles broadly and speaks directly to the camera. Behind her is a large white building with many windows, identifiable as a university campus. (2) She gestures towards the building with her hand. Graphical overlays with text and small logos appear around her. The environment is brightly lit by natural daylight. (3) The scene shifts indoors to a classroom or lecture hall. The woman, now wearing glasses and a headset microphone, stands at a podium in front of a projection screen displaying a text document. She is speaking to an audience off-camera. (4) The location changes to a brightly lit train station platform. The woman is now wearing a green blazer. She speaks with a more serious and sincere expression. A passenger in a suit walks by in the background. (5) In a final classroom scene, the woman in the green blazer sits at a grand piano, playing it skillfully. A group of students is visible in the background, some recording her with their phones.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 現在人在台藝. [Logo]: 國立臺灣藝術大學. (2) [Slogan]: 我跑來台藝教課了!!. [Variety]: 音樂系. (3) [Variety]: 緩慢備課中.... (4) [Logo]: 江老師 講課中. (5) [Subtitle]: 其實因為已經到學期末了. (6) [Subtitle]: 有一些同學比較少來上課. (7) [Subtitle]: 我就有一點生氣. (8) [Slogan]: 老師跟你一起想辦法!. (9) [Subtitle]: 走到最後.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with high energy and a fast pace, introducing her location. A gentle, melodic piano track plays at a low level in the background. (2) The voice remains expressive, with noticeable pitch variation and clear articulation, as she shares her excitement. The piano BGM continues. (3) The acoustic space shifts to an indoor room with light reverb. Background laughter is briefly heard, followed by the speaker continuing with a professional lecture tone. (4) In an outdoor station setting, the speaker's tone becomes more sincere and quiet. The piano music transitions to a softer, more emotional state. (5) The narration stops, and a bright, percussive live piano performance becomes the primary audio source, exhibiting a strong major-key melody.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator shares her personal milestone of becoming a university lecturer. She uses her experience to encourage students who may be struggling with attendance or motivation, demonstrating her commitment and passion through a live piano performance at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines vlog-style personal updates with a sincere message about education, using high-quality live piano as a core brand feature.
